name: ECE 3221
title: Digital Integrated Circuits
description: Switching, timing, wave shaping, and logic circuits to generate waveforms and functions used in pulse systems, instrumentation and computers. Emphasis is on integrated circuits.
requirement_description: ECE 3201; CSE 2300W or 2301; open only to students in the School of Engineering. This course and ECE 3222 may not both be taken for credit.
